patch.value: Investigate intermittent Node 26 LM fixture resource refusal under coverage

CI run https://github.com/unbraind/pm-rl/actions/runs/40038706857 at source 171b1254665714475facaf13fb2f24881cf221b9: npm Node 26 failed LM real fit publishes canonical tensors and rejects corrupt bytes, memory and token evidence at its initial valid-completion assertion with process_limit_exceeded (LM memory or token use exceeds its declaration). It passed 772/773 overall; missing coverage followed the early test exit. npm Node 22 and Bun Node 26 each passed the complete 773/773 release suite with 100 percent statements, lines, branches and functions. A focused isolated-identity Node 26 coverage retry passed 1/1 without changes. The original failure does not retain measured peak memory/token values, so its cause remains unconfirmed. Preserve all production limits and release thresholds; capture resource evidence, distinguish an actual limit violation from runtime measurement variability, and add an appropriate regression if a defect is established. This is outside the policy-card review fix.
Capture measured versus declared resources for the failing fixture; reproduce or explain the variability; preserve production resource enforcement and release thresholds.

value.text: Follow-up evidence: the unchanged resource enforcement passed all three full gates at source dc610cb8873ea5c1d9dd98cb87c122c466f9a3ea in CI https://github.com/unbraind/pm-rl/actions/runs/40042540881: npm Node 22/26 and Bun Node 26 each passed 774/774 at 100 percent in all four coverage dimensions. The original resource refusal also passed a focused Node 26 coverage retry 1/1. No resource limit or threshold was relaxed, and the intervening policy-card error-normalization correction did not change LM resource accounting. Keep this item open to capture the missing measured-versus-declared diagnostics and establish the cause of the earlier variability.
